images.title: Letters fill the boxes we cannot reach
images.purpose: Shows the pyramid with top 60 and bottom row 12, blank, 8 with the blanks named a, b and c, and the one equation that solves it.
images.composition: One three row pyramid in the centre with one equation underneath.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, generous empty margins, the main object large and centred. Six square boxes stacked as a pyramid: bottom row of three boxes holding 12, c and 8 from left to right; middle row of two boxes, each centred over the join of the two boxes below it, holding a and b; one top box holding 60. Boxes holding numbers have dark outlines; the boxes holding the letters a and b have amber (#E69F00) outlines; the box holding c has a thicker reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline. Below the pyramid, centred, the equation 20 + 2c = 60 in dark text, and to its right c = 20 in reddish purple. Exactly 6 boxes, no arrows, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Name the unknown boxes with letters, write the rule as equations, and solve.
